placements.why: The organization establishes dedicated new hire onboarding workflows, standardizing procedural enablement and retiring legacy ad-hoc documentation.
placements.title: Structured First-Week Onboarding and Enablement

placements.why: Wren Duskfield describes the mandatory Pallasine onboarding checklist covering accounts, pairing rotations, and shadow shifts completed during a new hire's first week, which replaced the previous wiki documentation.
